# Gauth Unlimited Digital Canvas : An AI tutor on an infinite whiteboard, not a chat thread

Gauth Unlimited Digital Canvas is a continuous digital whiteboard inside Gauth AI Course that turns any topic into a spatial, narrated visual lesson instead of a chat transcript or slide deck. Launched on October 1, 2026 through the company's launch announcement and featured on its Product Hunt launch page, it lays chapters side by side on one infinite board where notes write out in sync with AI narration and students zoom from a full concept map down to a single formula. [...] The canvas fits visual and spatial learners best: students who grasp systems faster from diagrams, timelines, and concept maps than from paragraphs. High-school and college students juggling mixed STEM workloads benefit most, since Gauth's coverage already spans algebra, calculus, physics, chemistry, and biology, and the App Store listing highlights extras like an AI Live Tutor with voice and whiteboard plus note-to-quiz converters and a study toolbox. [...] Traditional AI tutors answer in a vertical chat thread where each reply pushes the last one off screen. The canvas replaces scrolling with space: chapters sit next to each other, narration plays as board notes write themselves out, and pan-and-zoom controls glide between overview and detail. According to Daily AI Brief's report, the feature spans the platform's history and math libraries, and each session remembers its position and zoom level so students resume where they left off.

results.title: Gauth Launches Unlimited Digital Canvas, Gives Students One Continuous Whiteboard to Visualize, Explore and Understand Complex Topics
results.content:
SINGAPORE, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Gauth, the all-in-one study platform, today announced the launch of Unlimited Digital Canvas, a new whiteboard feature inside Gauth AI Course that works like a real tutor sitting next to a student. Instead of slides and separate chat messages, students and the AI Tutor now share one big board, writing and visually working through problems together in the same space. The update, now live across both history and math libraries, is the biggest change to how AI Course lessons are built and navigated since the product launched in July. [...] The update includes features to support learning without limits.

 3-Minute Mastery: Bite-sized courses that break down complex topics fast.
 Real Tutor Feel: Recreates the flow of a real 1-on-1 tutor session right on an endless whiteboard.
 Zero-Friction: Eliminates the steep costs, scheduling hassles, and social anxiety of traditional tutoring.
 Dynamic & Intuitive: Interactive spatial visuals and real-time AI guidance build a live mind map of the full topic, allowing you to zoom in on specific details without ever losing sight of the bigger picture. [...] When a concept doesn't land, students can pause and ask the AI Tutor a question at any point. The AI Tutor writes its explanation directly onto the board beneath the student's current step, keeping its reasoning visible right where the student is working.

"We didn't design Unlimited Digital Canvas around the shape of a textbook page, we designed it around the shape of a student's thought process," commented Alan Wang, Gauth CTO. "Learning isn't linear and with this canvas, students can finally move through a topic by zooming into a single detail or panning out to see the whole concept, picking up exactly where they left off, with the AI Tutor working in tandem so as a student works through a problem, the tutor can see exactly where their thinking is and step in at that exact point."
